methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: it was important to develop a method of comprehensively assessing each of these standards, ISO 50001, ISO 14001 and the SEBPs in relation to the LEED and BREEAM rating systems

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a maturity-model-based evaluation matrix mapping ISO 50001/ISO 14001/SEBP clauses onto LEED and BREEAM green-building rating credits; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (framework/maturity assessment without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content).

evidence_quote: The evaluation matrix was formed by assessing each standard in isolation
bases the evaluation on the levels of maturity defined by the SEAI

stage1.notes: Standards-vs-rating-system mapping study; demonstrative case study is a Cork medical-device (discrete) manufacturing site, not a continuous-process context.
